server.name: community-approval-queue
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 553 of Frame 3, block 5. Five tools, none annotated; request_approval is the only one that writes. The queue lives in HOME/.opafex/approval-queue/state.json, observed as a JSON document with the generated id and the requestedAt and expiresAt stamps declared away; list lengths are kept. request_approval is called with wait false: with wait true it blocks until a human decides through the CLI, which no trial can do.

fixtures.note: Files one approval request without waiting for a decision. list_pending reads the queue back as JSON; its generated id and time stamps are declared away.
